content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Visva-Bharati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Visva-Bharati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by Visva-Bharati for various teaching positions including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor across multiple departments located in Santiniketan, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies are available in this recruitment notification for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor roles spanning different academic disciplines and subjects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 31-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates are requested to apply through the official Chayan portal provided by Visva-Bharati.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Academic Level 10 posts?
faq.answer: The application fee for posts under Academic Level 10 is Rs. 1,600/-, payable online during the application submission process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Academic Level 14 and 13A posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for posts under Academic Level 14 and 13A are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 2,000/- online.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Assistant Professor posts must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks along with cleared NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree as per UGC guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal link provided on the Visva-Bharati website or directly via the Chayan portal at https://curec.samarth.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the short-listing of candidates based on their Academic and Research scores, followed by a final personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. What salary scale is applicable for Professor posts?
faq.answer: Professor posts are compensated under Academic Level 14 with an attractive entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
